title: SF allowable annual rent increase
rule: For rent-controlled units, the Rent Board sets the allowable annual increase for each March 1 to February 28 period, based on Bay Area CPI. Landlords may also impose increases they banked from earlier years when they did not raise the rent. Example from the Rent Board: $2,000.00 base rent at 1.6% becomes $2,032.00.
notes: 2022-23 and 2023-24 rates come from a secondary source and are unverified. Banking rules were not verified today.
